claim: Patchline ships an ISO-track certificate standard draft with normative grammar and conformance vectors. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the ISO-track standard claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make iso-track-certificate-standard-gate`.
